Title: Users can't reply or reply-all to email messages sent to Microsoft 365 groups in Exchange Online

User impact: Users can't reply or reply-all to email messages sent to Microsoft 365 groups in Exchange Online. 

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Exchange Online and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users can't reply or reply-all to email messages sent to Microsoft 365 groups in Exchange Online

User impact: Users can't reply or reply-all to email messages sent to Microsoft 365 groups in Exchange Online. 

Current status: We're reviewing support case details to better understand the impact scenario and determine our next steps.

Scope of impact: Your organization is impacted by this event and all users attempting to reply to email messages sent to Microsoft 365 groups are affected. 

Next update by: Friday, September 25, 2026, at 6:00 PM UTC

Title: Users may be unable to reply or reply-all to email messages sent to Microsoft 365 groups in Exchange Online

User impact: Users may be unable to reply or reply-all to email messages sent to Microsoft 365 groups in Exchange Online.

More info: As a temporary alternative, impacted users may reply or reply all to email messages through user inboxes.

Current status: We've identified a recent code change which we believe may be responsible for this issue and are developing a targeted fix to verify.

Scope of impact: This issue impacts any user attempting to reply or reply-all to email messages sent to Microsoft 365 groups in Exchange Online.

Next update by: Friday, September 25, 2026, at 11:00 PM UTC

Title: Users may be unable to reply or reply-all to email messages sent to Microsoft 365 groups in Exchange Online
